snippet.description:
Himanshi Ma’am, CSAT faculty at LevelUp IAS, explains why relying on just one section can be risky.

English accuracy can be unpredictable, so aspirants should prepare all three CSAT sections: Reading Comprehension, Reasoning, and Quantitative Aptitude. Build a balanced preparation strategy instead of depending on a single section to clear UPSC Prelims.

#UPSCCSAT #CSATStrategy #ReadingComprehension #UPSCPrelims #UPSC2027 #CSATPreparation #HimanshiMaam #LevelUpIAS #Shorts
